Postgres, redis and order-consumer show no errors.

verdict.recommendedAction: Engage the card processor (api.cardproc.example) owners and check their status and latency. Meanwhile, shorten the payment-svc timeout to the processor, add a circuit breaker so payment-svc fails fast, and watch the order-service to payment-svc connection pool. Once the processor recovers, confirm the pool drains and the 503 rate returns to baseline.
